effects: Once anyone submits the signature through delegateBySig, all of the signer's HOP voting power (current balance and any HOP received later) is delegated to `delegatee`.
Any earlier delegate is replaced: its votes from the signer move to the new delegatee.
The signer's nonce is used up. This nonce is shared with ERC-2612 permit, so a pending permit signed with the same nonce stops working.
The signature can only be used until `expiry` (a unix timestamp). No tokens move and no allowance changes.
formats.shown: "Delegate HOP voting power", with the delegatee address, the raw nonce and the expiry as a raw unix number (e.g. 1776816000).

findings.title: Delegation: expiry is shown as a raw unix number instead of a date.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: {"path":"expiry","label":"Expiry","format":"raw"}; case 0 screen shows Expiry "1776816000". ERC20Votes.sol delegateBySig: require(block.timestamp <= expiry, ...)
findings.fix: Use format "date" with params {"encoding":"timestamp"} and label it "Valid until".

findings.title: Delegation: no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line does not name the delegatee who gets the votes.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json format has intent "Delegate HOP voting power" and no interpolatedIntent. ERC20Votes.sol _delegate(signer, delegatee) moves all of the signer's votes to delegatee.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Delegate all HOP voting power to {delegatee}".

findings.title: Delegation: the nonce is shown as a field, but it is bookkeeping the signer does not choose.
findings.fix: Mark nonce as excluded or visible: never.

findings.title: Delegation: delegatee uses format raw instead of addressName, so no name can be shown.
findings.fix: Use format "addressName" with types ["eoa","contract"] and sources ["local","ens"].
